name: implent
description: Companions for building with AI: bearings lets people see the project, implementation-journal lets the next AI session pick up the work, and verify-kit provides high-signal verification, formal methods, blast-radius analysis, adversarial review, and root-cause hardening.

plugins.name: bearings
plugins.description: A visual map of a project that AI is building: its parts explained in plain words, a flow diagram of how each part works, the chain of functions behind it, and where recent work landed. For understanding only.

plugins.name: implementation-journal
plugins.description: Cross-session memory for AI coding work: one short record per task holding what the code and git cannot show (what was decided, what comes next) and a few plain lines for the person.

plugins.name: verify-kit
plugins.description: High-signal verification, formal methods (TLA+/SMT/PBT), blast-radius proof, adversarial review, git archaeology, and root-cause hardening skills adapted from cursor/plugins pstack.
